name: Zardy's Dating Sim
source:
It's that time of year again. The leaves turning shades of orange, yellow, and auburn. Children giggling and preparing their costumes for the one night of the year where they're allowed to rot their teeth out.

But as you lay your head to rest for the night, sounds from a nearby field keep you up. It's only when you hear a scream that you decide you need to investigate for yourself.

Lucky you! You get the chance to meet 6 lovely people within the maze: Zardy, Jack, Cablecrow, Brute, Rattler, and even ███ ██████  too! 

I'm sure they'll find you absolutely starfallen.

[From [url=https://wjester.itch.io/zardys-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]

A fan-fiction based on the horror game "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484800/]Zardy's Maze[/url]"
translation:
又到了一年中的这个时节。树叶染上橙黄与红褐，孩子们笑闹着准备服装，等待一年中唯一可以尽情吃糖、把牙齿都蛀坏的夜晚。

可当你躺下准备入睡时，附近田地传来的声响却让你无法安眠。直到一声尖叫传来，你才决定亲自前去查看。

你可真幸运！在迷宫里，你将有机会结识六位可爱的家伙，分别是扎迪、杰克、缆线稻草人、蛮力怪、响尾，甚至还有███ ██████！

相信他们一定会让你彻底坠入爱河。

[摘自[url=https://wjester.itch.io/zardys-dating-sim]itch.io[/url]]

本作为恐怖游戏《[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484800/]Zardy's Maze[/url]》的同人作品。
